Learn More Orthodontics for adults and children Book Now Call Now About Desert Valley We are committed to providing a positive experience for your child and building a foundation for healthy oral habits for life! Learn More Our Locations Our practice is committed to providing you and your family with safe, gentle, high-quality dental care. We understand that your child may feel anxious about visiting the dentist. We are sensitive to children’s needs and it is our goal to make your child feel comfortable visiting our practice while providing the best care possible. Find a Location Our Services Thousands of people have come to trust the friendly and honest approach of Desert Valley Pediatric Dentistry along with the easy appointment scheduling, flexible payment plans and convenient office location. Pediatric Dentistry Pediatric dentists are specialists in treating the oral health needs of infants and children through adolescence, including those with special health needs. Learn More about Pediatric Dentistry Preventative Procedures Preventive dental care means practicing good oral hygiene at home and scheduling regular checkups with your dentist. Learn More about Preventative Procedures Restorative Procedures A crown is a “cap” cemented onto an existing tooth. This restorative procedure can improve the shape or strength of a tooth. Learn More about Restorative Procedures Special Needs Dentistry We provide comprehensive preventive and therapeutic dental care to patients who have special healthcare needs. Learn More about Special Needs Dentistry Sedation Dentistry Sedation is most commonly used during extensive procedures or for patients with dental phobia or who find it difficult to sit still. Learn More about Sedation Dentistry Orthodontics An orthodontist is a doctor who specializes in realigning the jaw, teeth or bite patterns of a patient. Learn More about Orthodontics Digital X-Rays Digital X-rays can reduce your child’s exposure to radiation by up to 80% compared with traditional X-rays! Learn More about Digital X-Rays , Kid-friendly staff Affordable care Safe sedation options Convenient locations Bilingual team members AH CC C S Accepting most insurance + AHCCCS This place is AMAZING! They let you go back with your children and ALL the staff has always been great with all three of my kids, ages 2-10! They all love going to the dentist! We live 30 minutes away with like 8 dentists closer to us, we will travel always! They are the best! Leah D. Everyone was so nice and patient with my toddlers. They talked the kids through everything! My kids are always so excited to go to the dentist because this office makes it so much fun and so easy for them. Katherine B. The whole team at Desert Valley is wonderful!!! My daughter needed an emergency appointment, and they got her right in! They were so kind and quick, even being busy. Everyone there is so kind and great with the kids! Tera D. My daughters first dental visit (along with the follow-up visits) with this office was everything I hoped for. The staff made her feel comfortable and were very friendly and kind. Their office is very clean and kid approved decor, which is bright in color and cute. C. P. The staff was very courteous and respectful. My child had 4 teeth pulled and didn't even need Tylenol for pain. I will take my kids here again! Katie R.
